Crucially the cleaning, if anything, was GENEROUS to plain (it removed exactly the told/list-like annotations that depress the prose-quality keystone), and disclosure still won that axis 5.00 vs 4.22 — so the bias concern is CLEARED.

R504 accuracy correction (append-only, the R502 pattern; R504 itself is NOT mutated, frozen-ledger). R504's "harness drift recorded and repaired to R500 parity / repaired deterministically" OVERSTATES: git diff shows ZERO changes to crates/ or tools/, and assemble.rs still strips scaffolding unchanged. The "repair" was a MANUAL per-run production of .clean / .filtered files, not a code fix; the harness regressions (report-playthrough-manuscript --world no longer pruning, assemble not stripping in the live path) remain code DEBT. The craft result is credible (fairness cleared), but the "deterministic repair" wording must not be relied on as an audit fact.

Craft diagnosis (why plain still won overall 2-1 despite the keystone reversal). Disclosure WON prose-polish (keystone 5.00 vs 4.22; sustained close-third voice, never lectures the reader, flawless surface), but plain won the overall forced choice 2-1 because the whole-story judgment rewards NOVELISTIC RICHNESS — character, dialogue, emotional and thematic depth ("Pike keeps the forged wire because it is the only place the old man still is"), and a tighter forensic knot. Judge 3: "A reads like the finest possible outline executed as prose; B reads like a story someone is telling you." Per-structure pattern: disclosure WINS the withhold-structured ending (BURN — not-knowing is the point) and LOSES the reveal-structured endings (where withholding makes the climax a quieter retread). So disclosure is not universally better; the dial must match each world-line's dramatic intent.

Rung-2 design input 1 — render<->world-line FIDELITY gate (a real gap the experiment surfaced). Judge 1 found the disclosure W2 file labeled confront-burn delivered neither a confrontation nor a burn (a quiet-audit ending) — yet PIN-1 (contradiction) and PIN-2 (premature-leak) BOTH passed it, because the prose was a VALID-but-WRONG world-line. No gate checks "the rendered prose's world-line == the assigned world-line." Fix: (a) cheap — the render-brief pins the EXACT scene sequence for the world-line (report-playthrough-manuscript output), so the author cannot drift the path; (b) gate (if drift recurs) — re-extract -> resolve the prose's fork choices -> assert == the assigned branch, reusing report-fork-tree + world-line resolution, deterministic, AI out of the gate. This is the PROSE analog of R488's FactCanonOffBranch wrong-branch footgun.

Rung-2 design input 2 — emotional depth is CRAFT/brief, not a gate. The clinical-ness traces to a brief that over-specified MECHANICS (what to withhold) and under-specified CRAFT (character, emotion, theme) — the mirror image of R500's "state everything -> wooden". Fix: (a) author character INTERIORITY as belief-frame facts (the emotional WHAT is a perspectival fact: Pike's grief / motive-core), so warmth gets ANCHORED in the base and the render projects it (facts-first applied to emotion — but anchor load-bearing beats only, not a checklist, or it re-cools); (b) the render-brief must carry CRAFT GOALS (warmth, voice, theme), not just disclosure decisions — R500's "near-mechanical given the fact list" IS the cold-prose cause; (c) set the disclosure dial to each world-line's dramatic intent. Honest ceiling: the moving prose itself is model craft (R476) — substrate anchors, brief prompts, blind judge measures; no gate manufactures emotion.

Salience finding (the headline of this review). The hypothesis "too many unnecessary facts caused the problems" was tested against the stored data and REFUTED for this scale: the authored base is LEAN (52 facts / 29 scenes = 1.8/scene); the disclosure prose re-extracts to 2.07 facts/scene, LESS dense than the warmer plain arm's 2.21 (73/33); disclosure was also cleaner (D1+D2+D4=0 vs plain's 1) — R500's facts-first over-claim/bloat is GONE here, not present. So clinical-ness is not driven by fact COUNT. The valid kernel is at GAME scale: facts have NO salience / dramatic-weight axis (all equal weight -> the render cannot prioritize -> load-bearing facts dilute among ambient detail, the R476 relevance ceiling). The disclosure default-withhold SPARSE design is the intended mitigation (only load-bearing facts get an explicit disclosure decision = a de-facto salience filter), but this experiment UNDER-USED it — the brief said "state the focal frame's holding facts" (surface ALL) rather than a sparse selected few. Design input: a salience signal + rigorous sparse-disclosure use so a few load-bearing facts render warmly rather than many flatly.

Round 506 — disclosure rung-2 substrate.decision_summary: Designed the disclosure rung-2 substrate build (code 0, the R496/R499 pattern), authorized by R504's validation: a stored disclosure plan (a telling registry, schema v21 -> v22), the --telling render-brief carrier on report-playthrough-manuscript, and two deterministic render-acceptance gates (premature-leak per R502 + a NEW render<->world-line fidelity gate per R505) matched by typed-claim tuple to remove R505's manual-surgery caveat. Salience is EMERGENT from rigorous sparse default-withhold disclosure (not a new axis); emotion is belief-frame anchors + a craft-bearing brief (no new substrate). Build staged + pull-gated; the fact substrate is not redesigned.
changes_bullets: Mandate + scope. R504 validated disclosure-as-render-discipline (prose-quality keystone reversed 5.00 vs 4.22, both deterministic pins held) and authorized building the rung-2 substrate; this round DESIGNS that build (not the build), the R496/R499 code-0 pattern. The fact substrate is NOT redesigned (R500/R504 proved render-as-projection fidelity sound); sec 7.23's data model (R501) + gate boundary (R502) are taken as given and made buildable against the real substrate (NarrativeFact at narrative.rs, CanonOrder + FactCanonOffBranch + the continuity defect taxonomy at continuity.rs, Branch/fork_chain, the add_predicate registry pattern + CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION=21 + the AtomicStore shape at atomic/lib.rs, the report-* ops verbs at ops/lib.rs), folding in the two R505 inputs + the R505 salience finding. Grounded by a direct substrate survey, file:line refs in sec 7.24.

Schema v21 -> v22 (the new-field-default pattern, the v6 -> v7 epub_locator precedent). New top-level registry disclosure_plans: BTreeMap<telling-id, DisclosurePlan>, mirroring frames/branches/entities/predicates (R430/436/437/446). DisclosurePlan { description, default_mode (serde-default Withhold = the sparse-frame ethos, the R442 unmarked-default precedent), overrides: BTreeMap<fact-id, DisclosureOverride> }. DisclosureMode { Withhold | State | Hint | Imply }. DisclosureOverride { mode, first_at: BTreeMap<branch-id, coord>, surface: Option<DisclosureSurface> }. DisclosureSurface { scene: structure-ref, object: Option<entity-id> }.

The two R502 under-specs RESOLVED. first_at is per (fact x telling x WORLD-LINE) = BTreeMap<branch-id, coord> (reading order differs per branch, the R455/R466 per-world contract); coords are structure-section refs in CanonOrder space (the same space as canon_from). surface = a scene (structure ref) + an optional diegetic object (a registered entity = the Dark-Souls item) — reuses existing ref kinds, no new ref space; surface is STORED for the brief but NOT gated (the gate uses mode + first_at only).

Two gate FAMILIES kept distinct (scope-confusion guard). (1) STORE-INTEGRITY (validate-workspace / validate-continuity) gates the authored store, UNCHANGED — disclosure timing is a RENDER property, not a store invariant; the plan is new data the integrity scan ignores beyond ref-existence. (2) RENDER-ACCEPTANCE gates (NEW, run in the facts -> prose loop, NOT in validate-workspace) operate on (authored plan + the blind re-extracted prose) = the R500/R504 method.

Render-acceptance gate A = premature-leak (R502). A withhold-mode fact must NOT be re-extractable at all; a fact with an explicit first_at[W] must not be re-extractable strictly before first_at[W] in W's discourse order, mode-INDEPENDENT (withhold = first_at never). Timing reuses CanonOrder::le; strictly-before-and-comparable = LEAK, incomparable = an unordered honesty surface (the B-1 precedent). Disclosure-order DELEGATES to payoff (R442) where a setup -> payoff pin exists (absorb-don't-duplicate, the half-enforced-invariant guard). Gate scope = the explicit set (withhold + first_at facts) = exactly R504's pre-pinned-withhold-list set.

Render-acceptance gate B = render <-> world-line FIDELITY (R505 input 1, the NEW gate). The R504 footgun: a file labeled confront-burn delivered a quiet-audit ending and BOTH pins passed the valid-but-wrong world-line. Fix: the render-brief PINS world W's exact scene sequence = CanonOrder::linearize(W) (in-world scenes); after render+re-extract, every re-extracted canon_from C must be CanonOrder::names(W, C) (the R488 check, prose side) AND the terminal scene must be CanonOrder::is_maximal(W, .) (ends at W's ending, not another world's). Reuses CanonOrder + fork_chain + report-fork-tree (R497) — the PROSE analog of R488 FactCanonOffBranch.

The determinism KEYSTONE = typed-tuple matching (removes R505's manual-surgery caveat). Plan fact-ids live in the authored store; the re-extraction invents ids; R504 bridged them by HUMAN reading. The build bridges DETERMINISTICALLY: gate-targeted facts (withhold/first_at) MUST carry a typed TypedClaim, enforced fail-loud at set-disclosure (a disclosure decision on an untyped fact is un-gateable); the blind extractor is briefed with the entity+predicate REGISTRIES (vocabulary, NOT facts — the entity nouns are not spoilers, the withheld claim over them is) so typed claims are id-comparable; matching = (subject, predicate, object) tuple equality; unmatched -> an honesty surface, never a silent pass. SOUND for what matches (AI out of the gate); COMPLETENESS still rests on extractor recall (the same render-side-AI boundary R500/R504 always had). The win = the human mapping step is gone, not a perfect extractor.

Read surfaces (absorb-don't-duplicate). Carrier = a --telling flag on report-playthrough-manuscript (NOT a new verb, R501 step 2): per scene emits the disclosure decisions {state/hint/imply/withhold + surface} intersected with the focal --frame (rung-1); the craft-bearing brief R500's bare fact-list lacked. This step ALSO fixes the harness regressions (R505 input 3, same code path): --world re-prunes to in-world (begins>0), assemble re-strips scaffolding -> v2 reading copies are tool-produced, not hand-cleaned. report-disclosure-coverage --telling = SURFACE-NOT-GATE (disclosed / hidden-by-design / never-planned), the R442 dangling-is-a-todo discipline, the THIRD coverage instance (R389/R390 + R442 + this).

Mutate primitives (the add_predicate registry pattern: atomic fn -> CLI dispatch -> MCP tool). add-disclosure-plan (stage_registry_entry, fail-loud dup = the R436 typo guard) + set-disclosure (fail-loud: telling/fact exist, branch registered, coord real, surface object a registered entity, and the gate-enabling invariant: withhold or first_at requires the fact carry a typed claim). Field-invariant parity (CLAUDE.md guard): set-disclosure is the single override write path, but it + add-disclosure-plan share the existence invariants (parity test), and ANY future plan-write path must enforce the identical typed-fact + registered-ref invariants.

Salience (the R505 headline) = EMERGENT from sparse disclosure, NOT a new axis. R505 refuted fact-bloat (lean base 1.8/scene) and located the kernel at game scale: facts carry no dramatic-weight marker -> the render can't prioritize -> load-bearing facts dilute (R476 ceiling). Problem 1 — narrow scaffolding strip was a SILENT-FAIL (tools/experiment-harness assemble.rs reading_body). Lowercase prose "choice" is never a marker (uppercase-token rule); A)/B) option text + ENDING headers stay verbatim.

Problem 2 — --world emits the full composed-order scenes (its DESIGNED structural-manuscript contract, R466 — NOT a bug); the re-extracted store declared order as one base, so reach_for falls back to base and --world returns every scene, mixing other branches into a per-world reading copy. Fix: a new --reading-walk flag prunes each world to its content scenes (begins.len()>0, the R500 convention), applied at the ops layer (playthrough_manuscript_report) so the continuity verb stays the pure full manuscript; opt-in, default unchanged; wired CLI (--reading-walk) + MCP (reading_walk). This is the deterministic in-code prune that replaces the orchestrator's hand-made .filtered files.

Round 513 — warm-render posture frontier.decision_summary: R504's disclosure-craft experiment produced a split result its validated headline undersold: disclosure won the prose-quality keystone (5.00 vs plain 4.22) and tied or beat plain on all four measured axes, yet lost the holistic forced choice 2-1 on a quality the rubric undersamples — novelistic warmth. This round diagnoses that gap as render POSTURE, not missing data and not a raw model ceiling (R505's read): the same model wrote warmer prose in the plain arm from the same plot facts, so the differentiator is the JOB the prompt assigns — compliance (project this fact list under this disclosure plan, do not leak) makes the story serve the facts and reads like an outline; storytelling (tell the best story) makes the facts serve the story and reads warm. The lever is to relocate fidelity out of the author's prompt into the deterministic gates already built and proved (R507/R508/R512): render in a free storytelling posture, then gate-and-repair, so the author's job is plain's job and verification is the machine's. The round pins a controlled, measured acceptance experiment (warm render vs the reused R504 compliance render; fact base and disclosure plan held constant; posture the only varied variable) with an honest symmetric fork — a forced-choice flip proves posture was the cause, no flip proves the R476 model-craft ceiling on a clean comparison and authorizes a pivot to a different North-Star axis. Code 0; experiment execution is consent-gated.
changes_bullets: Diagnosed R504's 2-1 forced-choice loss (despite a keystone win at 5.00 vs 4.22 and parity or better on all four measured axes) as render POSTURE, refuting R505's model-craft-ceiling read: the same model wrote warmer prose in the plain arm from the same plot facts, so the differentiator is the JOB the prompt assigns — compliance fact-projection (the story serves the facts, reads like an outline) vs storytelling (the facts serve the story, reads warm) — not data and not ability.

Designed the warm-render protocol: a warm brief in narrative register carrying the SAME beats and withholds as the R504 compliance brief (no new story information, only the job re-registered, withholds encoded as story beats not fact-mode pins), then a gate-and-repair loop that runs the R508 leak and fidelity gates over a blind re-extraction and repairs only violations, scene-scoped and still in storytelling register; the lever is relocating fidelity out of the author's prompt into the gates we built and proved (R507/R508/R512). Explicitly NOT R505's add-emotion-anchor-facts (a longer checklist = more compliance = re-cool); anchoring is held out as a secondary lever.

Pinned a controlled acceptance experiment, disclosure-craft-experiment/v3: arm W = the new warm render gate-repaired to clean, arm C = R504's compliance disclosure render reused verbatim, with the fact base, disclosure plan, three world-lines, structure and ~9.4k-word budget held constant so render posture is the only varied variable; deterministic pins PIN-W1 fidelity (D1+D2+D4=0 and render-fidelity off_path=0 on the post-repair warm final) and PIN-W2 premature-leak (0 leaks, vocab_shared>0 per the R510 F5 guard); repair count and localization recorded as the posture tax; craft as 3 fresh blind judges on the R500 5-axis rubric over R509 harness-produced reading copies (W vs C primary, vs plain warmth-bar secondary, plus a re-cool sub-question).

Recorded the honest symmetric fork as a pre-committed decision rule: a forced-choice flip (W beats C, pins hold, repairs bounded, no judge-flagged re-cooling) proves posture was the cause and makes warm-render-then-gate-repair the standard render discipline (build implication YAGNI-deferred); no flip with pins holding proves the R476 model-craft ceiling on a clean controlled comparison and authorizes a pivot to a different North-Star axis (scale / pinion-projection / salience); warm-but-heavy-repair-re-cools is the measured partial. Code 0; the experiment execution is consent-gated; the fact substrate and the R507/R508 gates are taken as given.

Round 516 — assemble.rs strip root-cause.decision_summary: R516 root-causes in code the R509 silent-fail that recurred during R515, repaying it the textbook way (fix-don't-workaround, pay-debt-now) instead of the inline-Python source surgery R515 used as a workaround. The R515 owner session review surfaced it: the warm render wrote fork-choice bullets WITHOUT the literal CHOICE token (the form `- **CONFRONT** ... -> sc-09a`), plus a `## World-line and ending map` appendix and an interior `---` rule, and the experiment-harness assemble step silently passed all three into the blind reading copies (it stripped only the `### CHOICE` heading line, keeping the token-less bullets, the card intro, the map, and the rule). That is exactly the silent-fail class R509 set out to end, and R515 worked around it with a throwaway Python structural strip rather than fixing the harness. The fix is a single general rule in assemble.rs reading_body: a markdown heading inside a scene body opens a trailing structural section (a fork card or the world-line map) and is never prose, since the scene's own heading is the delimiter stripped before the body, so the body is truncated at the first heading; plus interior horizontal rules (`---`/`***`/`___`) are stripped as structural separators (story.rs trims only the one trailing rule, so an interior one before a trailing appendix reaches assemble). The now-redundant heading-CHOICE branch in is_scaffolding_line is removed (headings truncate before it runs); the R500 `CHOICE:`-directive convention (no heading) keeps its line-level `A)/B)` option text unchanged. New tests model the exact token-less-bullet, world-line-map, interior-rule, and prose-`#` forms; cargo test (24+4) and clippy -D warnings pass. Proof on the real R515 data: re-running the fixed assemble over the R515 sources with the verb-derived per-world order (no Python) reproduces the judged reading copies modulo four stray `---` lines on the warm arm (the WINNING arm), provably immaterial — no judge cited a horizontal rule and the marks disfavored the winner — so the R515 3-0 craft result is unaffected. Code change is scoped to tools/experiment-harness/src/assemble.rs. The experiment-copy re-validation (regenerate the canonical post-R516 copies and re-judge on them) and the remaining textbook items (PIN-W1 as a genuine per-world reading-copy re-extraction; replacing the inline-Python order/heading normalization with the report-playthrough-manuscript verb, whose per-world paths were verified byte-equal to the Python walk) are staged as the next rounds.

Round 517 — pre-commit Gate 5b: fmt + cl.decision_summary: R517 closes a pre-commit gate gap surfaced during R516: the in-repo crates that carry their OWN [workspace] table (tools/experiment-harness, bench/, studio/ — split out deliberately so the root workspace build/CI/pre-commit never compiles them, the build-speed reason) are never reached by the pre-commit fmt/clippy gates, which run cargo fmt --all and cargo clippy --workspace and therefore see only root members. The consequence bit in R516: the assemble.rs fix committed unformatted because no gate checked it (caught only by a manual cargo fmt --check afterward and amended). That is precisely the silent-fail class this repo bans — a gate that does not gate part of the codebase — and it is doubly pointed because the experiment-harness header calls the crate the repayment for the silent-fail Python it replaced, yet the crate itself was ungated. The fix is a new pre-commit Gate 5b that is structural, not hardcoded: for each staged .rs it walks up to the file's owning [workspace] root and, for any root other than the repo root, runs cargo fmt --manifest-path <ws>/Cargo.toml --check (loud reject on failure) and cargo clippy --manifest-path <ws>/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings on that workspace. It runs ONLY when such a file is staged, so the root gate stays fast and the build-speed rationale for splitting these crates out is preserved; and because it derives the workspace from structure, a future tools/<crate> with its own [workspace] is covered automatically (no list to maintain). pre-push is deliberately left root-only: it validates the publishable production workspace before publishing, while Gate 5b keeps all committed Rust — production and dev/experiment tools alike — clean at commit time. Validated end to end: the detection picks tools/experiment-harness + bench and skips root crates and non-.rs files; a deliberately fmt-dirty harness line, staged and run through the real hook, was REJECTED at Gate 5b (exit 1) with the manifest-scoped fix hint, then reverted clean. Recorded (not this round's scope): bench/ and studio/ carry pre-existing fmt drift the new gate will surface the next time either is edited — correct lazy enforcement, not a regression.

Everything through R515 tested RENDER (facts to prose) over a HAND-authored fact base; the untested, binding step is upstream — premise to a gate-clean, causally coherent, complete-enough fact base authored by the AI ITSELF (the scale-floor loop lost at 60 scenes on coverage; the standing conclusion is gates-sufficient, self-authoring-completeness-bound). This code-0 design round decomposes authoring into invention, completeness, and relevance and subjects each to the R493 refute-the-substrate discipline: invention is pure model work the mutate API already receives (no build); relevance/salience is already-decided emergent-from-sparse-disclosure (R506, no build); completeness splits into an IMPOSSIBLE general missing-fact detector (it would require already knowing the finished story = the R476 ceiling, the R494 extraction wall restated) and a CATALOG of STRUCTURAL smells mostly already built (R442/R485 payoff, report-timeline-gaps, report-fork-tree unplaced, R488 off-branch), whose only possibly-buildable lever is a thin aggregation read-surface that is YAGNI until an experiment shows pull. Conclusion (the R493/R495 pattern): the substrate is sufficient; the real test of this axis is an EXPERIMENT, not a build. The round designs ai-authoring-experiment/v1 — a blind author subagent gets only a premise plus the mutate-API vocabulary (no facts) and authors the fact base itself via the AI-first write-gate-read-repair loop, isolating authoring (premise to facts) from render (facts to prose) which every prior experiment conflated or skipped — with two deterministic pins (PIN-A1 convergence to gate-clean; PIN-A2 the structural completeness floor) and blind-judged causal coherence, contamination-bound (R469) and manifest sha-pinned at execution (R503/R514), plus a pre-committed decision rule routing the outcome to scale / the R476 ceiling / authoring-tooling. The North-Star framing guard holds: the AI is the author running its own gate loop, never AI-proposes-human-approves. No build, no experiment execution (gated).

Round 521 — top-down authoring + structu.decision_summary: From the post-R520 owner dialogue. R520 proved AI-self-authoring reachable at small scale but surfaced 2 blemishes the gates did not catch (a late-reveal harbourmaster sc-07e; a cross-branch prose allusion sc-07a), and R520 grouped both as the R476 ceiling. The owner punctured that on both counts, and this code-0 design round formalizes the corrections as the authoring discipline the SCALE axis requires. Honest refinement (append-only, R520 NOT mutated, the R502/R505 pattern): only case-1 (a MISSING setup) is the true ceiling — you cannot deterministically detect the absence of a fact whose necessity is a judgment; case-2 (a reference to a fact living only in a sibling world-line) is exactly the cross-branch reachability that R488 FactCanonOffBranch already decides for canon_from, and it slipped only because the allusion was free prose (no structural edge) and because evidence references are existence-checked but NOT reachability-checked (verified in code: continuity.rs:1165 existence-only vs the le() reachability at :126 applied to canon_from at the FactCanonOffBranch check). Piece A = the top-down authoring contract: redesign the bottom-up author-brief into phased top-down (scope + skeleton tentpoles first — each world-line's ending, the load-bearing entities, the fork, the major reveals AND their setups together — then detail fill); the substrate already supports any authoring order (facts placed by canon_from), so it is a CONTRACT change not a build; it seeds case-1 (the proof mechanism becomes a tentpole) and makes salience EMERGENT (the skeleton IS the load-bearing declaration, a second mechanism for the R505/R506 salience-is-emergent conclusion). Piece B = the structural backreference discipline: a claim may not allude in free prose; a backreference must cite the establishing scene in evidence, and the one small buildable lever is extending the R488 le() reachability check from canon_from to evidence (deterministic, AI-out-of-gate, same kind as FactCanonOffBranch — spine evidence passes, sibling-branch evidence fails), which catches case-2; built WITH the scale experiment per YAGNI, not now. Combined they fix both blemishes with no new substrate. This is the SCALE-axis input: the scale experiment authors at 60+ scenes under this contract, with the two known failure modes mitigated by construction so a coherence failure at scale would be a deeper finding.

Round 526 — precondition back-propagatio.decision_summary: The owner challenged R524's lone blemish — 'top-down should already have known what the branch needed.' The store bears the owner out, and this code-0 design round formalizes the precise failure as a refinement of the R521 top-down contract. The act-dig survivor was KNOWN at the skeleton stage (the Phase-0 tentpole f-071 reads 'the survivor confirms…'); the entity theo was spine-grounded (sc-08); what slipped is a new STATE (Theo alive) that answers a question gt left silent — the spine carries the gang's death only as a vigil (mood) and a town-belief, never as a ground-truth fact, so the reveal contradicts nothing (coherence 5/5) yet resolves an unplanted question. R521's contract modeled the reveal's PAYOFF relationship (f-071 pays off the seeded warning) but had no slot for the new state the reveal INTRODUCES. The refinement (Piece A v2): in Phase 0, for each reveal, decompose every fact it asserts and SEED every new precondition — a new entity gets an establishing beat, a new state/answer gets its question opened earlier as a payoff_expectation:expected setup the reveal pays_off, and gt must take a position (or mark open) any question a belief frame raises. Recognized preconditions, modeled as setup->payoff pairs, ride the EXISTING report-payoff-coverage gate (no new gate), shrinking the R476 ceiling to preconditions the author never recognizes. A new entity-first-appearance gate was REFUTED (the slip was a state not an entity; foreshadowing-necessity is the R476 judgment ceiling). No build; the clause is the verbatim Phase-0 text the next authoring run's author-brief instantiates.
changes_bullets: design-doc sec 7.28 = the Piece A v2 contract clause (precondition back-propagation) — the verbatim Phase-0 text the next top-down author-brief adds.

Honest refinement of R524 (append-only, R524 NOT mutated): the act-dig survivor was NOT a late discovery — the Phase-0 ending tentpole f-071 literally names "the survivor", and the entity theo (Margaret's brother) was spine-grounded at sc-08 (her vigil). What slipped is a NEW STATE ("Theo is alive") that ANSWERS a question the spine left silently open: gt never asserts the gang dead (only f-103 gt vigil + f-111 town-belief), so the survivor contradicts no fact (0 violations, coherence 5/5) but resolves an unplanted question. R521's setup->payoff framing has no slot for an enabling precondition = the leak path.

The rule: in Phase 0, for each reveal tentpole, decompose every asserted fact into (a) a setup it pays off / (b) already-established or reader-derivable / (c) a NEW precondition (a new entity OR a new world-state resolving a question / cutting against the reader's assumption). Every (c) is seeded before the reveal — a new ENTITY gets an establishing beat, a new STATE/ANSWER gets its QUESTION opened earlier as a payoff_expectation:expected setup the reveal pays_off. Frame corollary: if gt is silent on a question a belief frame raises, gt must take a position or mark it open.

The mechanism reuses R442 (no build, no new gate): a recognized precondition is modeled as a setup->payoff pair, so the EXISTING report-payoff-coverage gate backstops it deterministically — recognized preconditions become gate-enforced; the R476 ceiling shrinks to preconditions the author never recognized.

Refuted (the R493 discipline): a NEW "entity first-appearance reachability" gate — REFUTED, because the slip was a STATE not an entity (Theo was grounded) and "which new states need foreshadowing / cut against the reader's assumption" is the R476 commonsense ceiling no deterministic checker captures. The lever is the CONTRACT + the payoff-coverage backstop, not a gate.

Round 527 — convergence-JOIN frontier SC.decision_summary: Post-R524 the owner resolved the scope-fork to the convergence-JOIN axis and supplied a code-grounded investigation of how far the substrate expresses a Crimson-Desert-class open-world scenario. This code-0 scoping round (the R518 pattern: scope a frontier in one round, design/refute in the next) captures that investigation, grounds its central claim in code, and hands the design to the next session. Finding: the substrate is a branching-narrative + worldbuilding-consistency-bible engine — its main-spine / key-branch / Frame-asymmetry / Predicate-state / payoff-consistency layers are the right shape and small-scale-proven, but the open-world essence (free-order subquests = combinatorial explosion, availability gating as a first-class concept, a quest unit, conditional world simulation, and raw scale) has no vocabulary. The convergence-JOIN core, verified in code not asserted: Branch.forks_from is a single immutable parent (narrative.rs:82, 'fork ancestry is a forest by construction'), fork_chain is a linear single-parent walk, and CanonOrder + le() reachability assume that forest — so the model expresses fork (divergence) ONLY; a JOIN needs a node with two-or-more parent world-lines = a DAG/lattice the single forks_from cannot hold, and the owner's free fork-join-fork-join alternation is a general series-parallel lattice = a genuine STRUCTURAL (new-substrate) gap, unlike R521/R526's contract gaps. A naming-collision guard is recorded (the persistence 'convergence-B' index already owns 'convergence'; the narrative world-line JOIN/merge must stay terminologically separate). The next session's DESIGN round answers the five scoped questions in sec 7.29: refute-first, representation, the hard merge SEMANTICS (what holds at a join when the joining lines disagree on state), free alternation, and the JOIN-vs-concurrency distinction (a diamond join of exclusive branches is not the same as concurrent AND-thread free-order subquests). No build, no experiment, no substrate change this round.

The headline code finding sharpens every answer: the order ALGEBRA — closure_of's transitive closure, le() reachability, linearize()'s Kahn topo-sort, is_maximal/names — is ALREADY a general DAG machine (continuity.rs:263 states the closure of a DAG topo-sorts identically to it), so the 'forest by construction' constraint does NOT live in the order layer; it lives in exactly three named places: the single-parent Branch.forks_from (narrative.rs:82), the chain-shaped fork_chain/fork_ancestry (narrative.rs:104 / continuity.rs:991), and the single-lineage visibility/join_world (continuity.rs:1019/1042). A world-line JOIN is therefore a BOUNDED generalization of the ANCESTRY layer, not a rewrite of the order algebra. Scoped to the exclusive-OR diamond, the JOIN is a write-once SHARED continuation (a path-dependent prefix plus a suffix authored once), NOT a state-merge; its soundness is the R488/R522 reachability family checked per-incoming-parent ('no unreconciled dependency across a confluence'), with explicit reconciliation expressed by a bounded cross-confluence extension of supersedes_in_frame succession. Concurrency / free-order / availability-gating is a DISTINCT future substrate axis, not folded in. changes_bullets: Q1 REFUTE-FIRST — gap CONFIRMED: three existing-means candidates all fail. (a) a within-ONE-branch canon diamond (a->b, a->c, b->d, c->d) is handled by le() but b AND c both occur in EVERY playthrough of that branch = concurrency-within-a-world, not exclusive reconvergence. (b) duplicating the continuation onto both branches yields two DISTINCT facts (NarrativeFact.branch is a single String, narrative.rs:336) = no shared node identity, the fork-tree shows two leaves not a merge, payoff/continuity gates treat them independently = defeats write-once. (c) a third branch forks_from one parent inherits ONLY that one parent. The single immutable forks_from is the hard blocker; the gap is real (matches R527).

Q2 REPRESENTATION — a world-line gains a MULTI-parent merge declaration (working term `confluence`: the BranchFork {branch, at} shape as a SET, not Option-singular). SURVIVES UNCHANGED (the order algebra is already DAG-general): closure_of / le() / comparable / linearize (Kahn) / is_maximal / names. MUST GENERALIZE chain->DAG: fork_chain (single-parent walk -> ancestor-SET collection, the hop-cap stays as the DAG acyclicity guard); fork_ancestry (Vec chain -> transitive ancestor set); CanonOrder::from_declaration's composition loop (already iterates ancestry as a collection, so it generalizes for free once ancestry yields the full set); visibility / Lineage.cut (one cut -> a cut per parent path); join_world (lattice-meet over a DAG). The acyclic invariant is preserved: a confluence may not merge a branch into its own ancestor.

Q3 SEMANTICS (the crux) — SCOPE to the exclusive-OR diamond ==> a JOIN is a PATH-DEPENDENT continuation that SHARES authored facts, NOT a state-merge. Any single playthrough traverses EXACTLY ONE incoming line, so "what holds at the confluence" is W1's-prefix OR W2's-prefix plus the shared suffix authored ONCE. The primitive buys WRITE-ONCE shared continuation (author the ending once, both lines inherit) = directly attacks the forest's duplication tax (all-roads-lead-to-the-ending without authoring it N times). The soundness GATE (the R488/R522 le() analog) = "no unreconciled dependency across a confluence": every fact visible in the shared continuation must have its support (evidence / pays_off targets / referenced entity-state) reachable from EVERY incoming parent via le() checked PER-PARENT; a continuation fact depending on a prefix present on only SOME entries = the false-merge bug = REJECT (deterministic, AI-out-of-gate, the R502 family).

Q3 cont. RECONCILIATION — where content MUST differ by entry, you do NOT converge (stay forked) OR author an explicit reconciliation at the confluence: the EXISTING supersedes_in_frame succession with ONE bounded exception — succession may cross INTO a confluence node from its parents (today SuccessionCrossBranch, continuity.rs:840, rejects ALL cross-branch succession; the confluence is the single principled exception, a successor there supersedes each parent's divergent belief). No state-reconciliation ENGINE and no auto-merge logic (that = the R476 ceiling / world-simulation / pinion territory, deliberately out).

Q4 FREE ALTERNATION — fork->join->fork->join GENERALIZES to a series-parallel DAG, CONDITIONAL on Q2's multi-parent ancestry. Kahn linearize() already topo-sorts any DAG (continuity.rs:263 "the closure of a DAG topo-sorts identically to it"); le() answers cross-lattice reachability once from_declaration composes over the ancestor SET. The ancestor-CHAIN is the ONLY thing replaced. Multi-parent ancestry is MORE general than series-parallel (allows arbitrary acyclic merges); an optional "well-formed diamond" structural surface (every confluence's parents share a fork ancestor; the R442/R488 report-not-gate family) is DEFERRED — do not constrain mechanically up front.

Q5 JOIN vs CONCURRENCY — SEPARATE AXES, do NOT fold in. Convergence-JOIN = the exclusive-OR diamond (one path per playthrough -> tractable as sharing + per-parent reachability, this scope). Concurrency / quest-graph = AND-threads, author-free interleaving, availability GATING, state COMBINED (real conflicts), a quest unit (R527 open-world gaps #1/#2/#3) = the combinatorial explosion; it needs a different model (an independence/concurrency relation — event-structure / Mazurkiewicz-trace shape — plus a gating/precondition layer), its own future R518-style scope round. Folding it in would import the explosion into an otherwise clean bounded generalization.

BUILD DECISION — DESIGN captured, BUILD DEFERRED behind an authoring run that HITS the wall (the R493/R495/R518/R521 doctrine: build only when an experiment shows pull; R524 SCALED to 70 scenes inside the forest with NO merge needed, so there is no pull yet). The next authoring/scale run's brief gains a many-world-lines-converge-to-one-ending requirement; if the forest forces ugly duplication or the author cannot express the shared continuation, THAT failure is the build trigger (exactly how R521's contract -> R524's scale run worked). Round 529 — open-world production-pipeli.decision_summary: A code-0 capture round recording the owner's post-R528 North-Star dialogue, which zoomed out from the convergence-JOIN sub-question to the whole open-world production pipeline (authoring -> render -> SCXML -> runtime). The dialogue established: (1) narrative progression maps cleanly onto a compilable deterministic state machine, and SCXML already has the exact vocabulary the branch model lacks (cond guards = state-gating, parallel = concurrent AND-threads, transitions = forks, converging transitions = the R528 JOIN); (2) the AI<->code seam is FACTS — the AI authors structured facts (R524), a deterministic codegen emits SCXML (the report-fork-tree / manuscript / linearize precedent), nobody hand-writes code; the real open seam is how much executable behavior is fact-expressible (codegen, drift-free) vs hand-authored SCXML and only verified; (3) warm render reads FACTS, not SCXML — SCXML emits a pointer (scene + world-line), render projects the facts there, matching the R514/R515 facts-only render and the CQRS pointer-projection; (4) production order = facts-first (SSOT) then render + codegen as projections; (5) render is build-time pre-baked per NODE (scene x world-line), not per path — node-not-path keeps it linear/tractable, confluence cuts the bake count, runtime is navigate+display with no runtime LLM = deterministic; (6) the owner CORRECTED the 'N! explosion' framing — free-order is constraints (partial order + independence) not enumerations, the canon-order DAG already works this way; (7) a 3-level taxonomy: L1 structural fork/join (= R528 confluence), L2 state-gated fork/join (= the gating axis, R527 gap #4), L3 free-order AND-threads (= SCXML parallel); L1+L2 are the exclusive-per-playthrough tractable bundle the owner wants, they layer cleanly (structure -> conditions); (8) the story-graph is already visualizable (report-fork-tree, demonstrated live on the detroit 7-world-line store); a visual GUI is a substrate-0 presentation layer, unbuilt + YAGNI-gated; the full visual = pinion; (9) 100-NPC dialogue = a render projection of (personality entity-facts + the NPC's Frame/knowledge + the pointer), bounded as a node matrix, kept knowledge-consistent by the gates = the consistency-bible strength. THROUGH-LINE: every projection/execution layer is proven or cheap; the ONE binding bottleneck across all of them is AI SELF-AUTHORING at scale + breadth + coherence. No build, no decision committed; this is a frontier map plus the recommended next probe.
changes_bullets: EXECUTABLE-NARRATIVE FIT: narrative progression = a compilable deterministic state machine, and SCXML already carries the vocabulary the branch model LACKS — `<transition cond=>` = state-gating, `<parallel>` = concurrent AND-threads, transitions = forks, transitions-into-a-shared-state = the R528 JOIN. SCE (the sibling engine) builds/runs SCXML deterministically; the CQRS frozen-substrate + pointer-projection framing makes "compiled story machine + runtime traversal" consistent with the established architecture.

THE AI<->CODE SEAM = FACTS (resolves the owner's "AI authoring isn't code, how do you connect them"): the AI authors STRUCTURED FACTS via the mutate API (R524: 85 facts / 7 branches = data, not prose, not code); a DETERMINISTIC codegen emits SCXML from those facts — the report-fork-tree / report-playthrough-manuscript / linearize precedent (facts -> artifact, NO AI in the generation step). Nobody hand-writes code. The REAL open seam = how much executable behavior is fact-expressible (codegen, option B, drift-free) vs must be hand-authored SCXML and only VERIFIED (option A, the proven SCE pattern) = the declarative-truth / executable-behavior boundary.

WARM RENDER READS FACTS, NOT SCXML (resolves "must warm render read the SCXML"): SCXML/SCE emits only a POINTER (current scene + world-line); render projects the FACTS at that pointer into warm prose. They meet at the pointer (data), never touch XML — the web router/renderer split. Consistent with the PROVEN R514/R515 warm render (facts-only) AND the memory's CQRS pointer-projection. Decoupled: progression rules and render voice are independently swappable/verifiable.

PRODUCTION ORDER = facts-first: author + gate the fact base (SSOT) -> render (facts->prose) + codegen (structure facts->SCXML) are downstream PROJECTIONS. The R495 facts-first insight, applied as the game-build pipeline.

RENDER IS BUILD-TIME PRE-BAKED PER NODE, not per path: render each reachable (scene x world-line [x telling]) NODE once at build time; paths through the DAG are exponential but NODES are linear (~hundreds for a 70-scene / 7-branch story) — "render the graph, not the playthroughs." Confluence (R528) shares a converged continuation = renders it ONCE (cuts the bake count). Runtime = navigate (SCXML pointer) + display the pre-baked prose; NO runtime LLM = deterministic + QA-able + zero per-play cost (the determinism the owner required).

"N! EXPLOSION" CORRECTED by the owner (honest self-correction): free-order is expressed as CONSTRAINTS (a partial order + independence = no edge), NOT by enumerating orderings; the author freely chooses how constrained (fully ordered / fully free / between), and the valid orderings FOLLOW from the constraints — never materialized. Round 533 — convergence-JOIN build step.decision_summary: Build step 2 of the R528/sec-7.30 convergence-JOIN arc, pull-justified by R531's OUTCOME-1 (the blind author was forced to duplicate the shared ending 6 beats x2 because a fact carries one branch and the forest has no native join node). The MODEL, decided in R528 Q3 and field-confirmed by R531: the order algebra (closure_of/le/linearize, Kahn) is ALREADY a general DAG machine, so 'forest by construction' lived only in the ANCESTRY layer (single-parent fork_chain + single-lineage visibility) — a JOIN is a bounded generalization of that layer, NOT an order-algebra rewrite. A query world W's composition = its backward fork ancestors (fork_chain) union {W} union its FORWARD confluence-suffixes (every confluence C where W is transitively in C.converges_from). A fact authored ONCE on C is visible (holds_at) in EVERY converging parent world past the merge and not before (visibility is structural membership; the composed order bounds the timing) — so R531's 2x duplication is removed by construction (12 shared-tail facts become 6). The confluence itself is not a query world (exclusive-OR: one playthrough = one parent path + the shared suffix; querying the merge as a standalone world would union nothing useful and surface false dangling-payoff findings). Cross-merge conflict reconciliation (a suffix fact vs a parent-middle fact, and cross-confluence succession) is the explicit R534 scope, not this round — confluence is new substrate, so deferring it is a staged build, not a regression or a half-enforced invariant.

Cross-merge conflict reconciliation (a suffix fact vs a parent-middle fact, and cross-confluence succession) is the explicit R534 scope, not this round — confluence is new substrate, so deferring it is a staged build, not a regression or a half-enforced invariant.

SSOT?) — the R510 review pattern. Honest verdict: R533 is correct, tested, squarely on the North Star (convergence/JOIN = the L1 structural-join substrate the open-world AAA-narrative goal needs), and it IMPROVED SSOT — query_worlds extracted six duplicated per-world sweep constructions into one source, the holds_at/visibility predicate changed exactly once (R390), and the forward walk is single-sourced in core::forward_confluences mirroring fork_chain. ONE genuine structural smell: CanonOrder::from_declaration is a medium-agnostic order-closure algebra, but R533 passed it TWO maps (backward ancestry, forward confluence-suffixes) that it merged identically — leaking the narrative backward/forward distinction into the algebra, plus an include-all-vs-filter asymmetry between fork_ancestry and fork_confluences. Round 535 — convergence-JOIN build step.decision_summary: Round 535 — convergence-JOIN build step 3: the per-parent CONFLUENCE RECONCILIATION gate ("no unreconciled dependency across a confluence"), closing the R534-recorded cross-merge scope (the R528-Q3 reconciliation). THREE parts over the existing order algebra (no schema change — R532's converges_from suffices): (a) CONFLICT scoping — join_world generalized with a FORWARD case: when one fact is on a confluence the other's branch flows INTO (Lineage.forward), the JOIN world is the PARENT (the suffix is visible there), so a suffix-vs-parent-middle conflict co-holds and is caught — the pair R533/R534 left bucketed as cross_scope_pairs; the sibling-confluence-common-parent case stays unscoped (the deferred series-parallel generalization, surfaced not silent). (b) SUCCESSION reconciliation — cross-branch supersedes_in_frame is now legitimate in TWO inheritance directions via a SINGLE new core predicate mnemosyne_core::succession_branch_inherits (predecessor a backward fork-ancestor OR successor a forward confluence-suffix), called by BOTH enforcement points (the write-path check_succession_edge in mnemosyne-atomic AND the scan re-check in continuity.rs) so the multi-write-path invariant cannot drift (the two-write-path-one-invariant discipline; the prior backward-only write-path stayed stricter than the relaxed scan, which a failing test caught — the relaxation would have been dead code); bounded — it authorizes the edge, computes no merged state (no auto-merge engine). (c) the per-parent dependency GATE — the R488/R522 le() evidence-reachability, for a fact on a confluence, checked from EVERY incoming parent against the fact's own canon_from (which routes through that parent's merge coordinate in its composed order — NOT converges_from.at, so suffix-internal evidence reaches correctly), emitting a NEW ConfluenceEvidenceUnreconciled when evidence is reachable from only one parent; this ALSO fixes a latent false-positive (a confluence's own order is prefix-less, so the pre-R535 le(confluence, ...) wrongly flagged legitimate trunk/shared evidence). Byte-stable for pre-confluence stores (the non-confluence path is byte-identical to R522; forward sets are empty). VERIFIED: 4 new tests (the core predicate 4-direction parity unit test = the invariant SSOT; conflict-scopes-to-parent; succession reconcile-accepted/sibling-rejected; evidence reconciled-per-parent) + full suite (atomic 184 / validate 259 / workspace green) + clippy -D + fmt + live-store validate clean (281, byte-stable) + an end-to-end CLI smoke (a Harlow Mill diamond built via add-branch --converges; validate-continuity --json surfaced exactly the one confluence_evidence_unreconciled with parent=ride, cross_scope_pairs=0). NEXT (R536) = re-run convergence-probe/v2 (the fork->join validation: the shared ending authored ONCE, the merge gate exercised, the R531 12->6 duplication tax confirmed removed).

Round 538 — explicit CLI path overrides.decision_summary: Round 538 — explicit CLI path overrides resolve CWD-relative (the textbook fix surfaced by R537's de-risk; foundation primitive, owner-requested cost-no-object review). The convergence-probe/v2 de-risk surfaced that a relative --sidecar / --order CLI override resolved against the WORKSPACE ROOT (cascade::resolve_sidecar joined the anchor = the discovered root the CLI feeds via workspace_anchor), NOT the CWD — so an explicit relative --sidecar from a subdirectory silently planted a store at the repo root, AND the code VIOLATED its own doc comment ('a relative override joins the dir the command was invoked against' = CWD). The textbook root-cause fix (the R510/R534 review bar): an EXPLICIT CLI path argument is CWD-relative (the universal CLI convention, least surprise — like --manifest and every standard tool), while a config-DECLARED path ([atomic] sidecar_path / [continuity] canon_order_path) stays workspace-root-relative (a project-level declaration). SSOT restored: ONE new pure rule resolve_explicit_cli_path(cwd, raw) shared by BOTH --sidecar (resolve_sidecar) and --order (resolve_canon_order_file) so the two cannot drift to different anchors; a functional-core / imperative-shell split (the pure resolve_sidecar_in + resolve_explicit_cli_path are unit-tested, the thin resolve_sidecar / resolve_canon_order_file shells inject the process CWD). Blast radius = 0 regression (no hook/script passes an explicit relative --sidecar/--order; repo-root invocations have CWD == workspace_root, identical), verified by full suite + clippy -D + fmt + an e2e smoke (a relative --sidecar from a subdir now lands in the CWD, repo-root pollution gone). On-axis: a mutate-API-safety / tool-ergonomics fix that also removes the absolute-path crutch the R537 author-brief had to carry.

Diagnosis: soft rules are ignorable (R526 sec-7.28 was ignored at R541), only hard gates count, and a hard gate can read only structure not prose (AI-out-of-the-gate). The hole-class's true nature is a possession/state error (the bond in the wrong hands on this branch), whose deterministic catch needs per-branch possession/location state + predicate exclusivity = WORLD-STATE SIMULATION = the R527 'world-state recorded-not-simulated' axis = a large axis, not a small gate. DECISION: the cheap prose-ghost gate REFUTED (do not build, noisy + evadable); the real lever deferred to its own R527 world-state scope round behind real pull (n=2 is not it); for now the blind judge is the floor's backstop (caught sc-32 3/3) and the R526 soft clause stays as incidence-reducing guidance. Round 560 — boundary correction: declara.decision_summary: R560 = an append-only BOUNDARY CORRECTION refining the Mnemosyne / SCE-pinion split that the R559 surrounding discussion stated imprecisely (the R450/R498/R502/R505 append-only-refinement pattern; R559/R546/R547 NOT mutated, frozen ledger respected). The owner's probing surfaced two imprecisions in my EXPLANATIONS (the R559 entry body was correct: declarative structure = Mnemosyne, execution = SCE/pinion; my looser restatements drifted). CORRECTION 1: the dividing axis is DECLARATIVE-TRUTH vs EXECUTION, NOT simple-vs-complex. A guard CONDITION, however complex (nested AND/OR over facts, e.g. (A and B) or C), is a statement of world-state = Mnemosyne, projecting to an SCXML cond (R546 placed cond guards on the world-state side, R547). Only the side-effecting executable content (assign / script / send / the running interpreter) is SCE. I had loosely said complex guard = SCE; complexity is not the line, truth-vs-execution is. CORRECTION 2: PLAYING is NAVIGATION / SELECTION over the frozen map, not a time-flowing execution engine. The binding model is the memory's frozen-substrate pointer projection, NOT frame accumulation (CQRS read-side): the player's choice-path selects a world-line, and pinion / the visualizer looks up Mnemosyne's PRE-COMPUTED per-world-line projection (R557 playable-world, R559 quest-graph) and renders it. The visualizer is a cursor + renderer (a preview / test affordance for the author or AI, and the ship-time player path is the same), holding only the choice-path; there is NO executing engine in the discrete branching-narrative core, and quest STATE is DERIVED per world-line (holds_at + disclosure + payoff), never stored. I had overstated this as SCE/pinion executing flowing-time play. WHEN SCXML IS GENUINELY NEEDED (so the correction does not erase it): only at the EXECUTION edge — (1) concurrency / parallel (SCXML parallel regions + event queue + join: the R549 / R546 interfering-AND-thread edge that the exclusive-OR fork tree cannot express); (2) event-driven / real-time reaction (send / timers / invoke); (3) AOT codegen to a target language or formal verification (reachability / model-check) = SCE's stated purpose. The discrete branching core needs NO SCXML (KISS; SCXML there is over-engineering); whole-narrative-as-SCXML is POSSIBLE but only NEEDED where execution semantics buy something. Mnemosyne FEEDS SCXML (fork_tree to topology, world-state to cond) but does not store or execute it; the facts-to-SCXML adapter is R546-designed and unbuilt (pull-gated); executable SCXML is SCE. This split is symmetric for spec and narrative (one substrate, spec is one instance of narrative) — the only narrative-extra is a live PLAYTHROUGH a static spec lacks, and even that is navigation + an optional continuous-state edge (accumulating counters / inventories with combinatorial guards / R549 live contention) that is pinion-side, optional, deferred, not Mnemosyne's role and not required for the core. No code, no schema, no gate; the deliverable is this entry + the design sec 7.38 boundary note. NEXT = R561 owner scope choice (the R559-deferred fork, unchanged).

Only the side-effecting executable content (assign / script / send / the running interpreter) is SCE. I had loosely said complex guard = SCE; complexity is not the line, truth-vs-execution is. CORRECTION 2: PLAYING is NAVIGATION / SELECTION over the frozen map, not a time-flowing execution engine. The binding model is the memory's frozen-substrate pointer projection, NOT frame accumulation (CQRS read-side): the player's choice-path selects a world-line, and pinion / the visualizer looks up Mnemosyne's PRE-COMPUTED per-world-line projection (R557 playable-world, R559 quest-graph) and renders it. Mnemosyne FEEDS SCXML (fork_tree to topology, world-state to cond) but does not store or execute it; the facts-to-SCXML adapter is R546-designed and unbuilt (pull-gated); executable SCXML is SCE. Round 565.decision_summary: R565 = an INVESTIGATION/ESTIMATE round (code 0; the owner's R564-followup), scoping the EFFORT of closing the D1 residue (the R564 named limit — the dead delver's identification of the villain is summarized off-page backstory) by a REAL story expansion rather than a surgical repair. Grounded in the actual dnd-quest v2 base (52 scenes / 123 facts / 11 frames / the delve disclosure plan, read not mutated); estimates expressed in substrate units (frames / scenes / facts / gate re-runs / render + judge scope), not invented hours (the no-fake-metrics rule). Three tiers were priced: (1) light = a concrete journal entry (~2-4 facts, no disclosure rework, roughly a surgical repair); (2) medium = a living corroborator (~3-6 facts, 0-1 new scene/frame); (3) full flashback = authoring the delver's investigation as real on-page scenes, the "real expansion" the owner asked to scope. Tier (3) against this base concretely needs: +1 frame (the base has a delver ENTITY but no delver POINT-OF-VIEW frame), +3-5 prologue scenes (a sc-00a..sc-01 chain prepended to the spine — the substrate places scenes at any canon coordinate), +~10-18 facts (the delver's observations + the ground-truth deeds + the existing journal fact f-130 re-pointed to pay off the shown scenes), taking the game 52->~56 scenes and 123->~138 facts — TRIVIAL versus the proven scale (R545 95 scenes, R524 70). So VOLUME is not the cost driver. The ONE genuinely hard part (the real 공수) is the withhold/leak interaction: the mystery turns on f-004 (the cause is Brother Vane) being withheld until sc-14, and a naive flashback showing Vane's face early would make the identity re-extractable before its first_at and FAIL the leak gate. The saving grace, found in the real base: the DEED is already PUBLIC (f-051, Old Maeve — "someone living must be feeding the water" — is NOT withheld) and only the IDENTITY is withheld (f-004 = it is Vane); so the clean expansion shows the delver watching a ROBED/UNNAMED figure tip the bodies and tracking the trail toward the shrine, with the naming still landing at sc-14 — adding dramatic irony about the deed while preserving the who-mystery. The cost there is DESIGN CARE, not volume: type the prologue facts about "a robed figure" never subject=Vane so the leak gate's typed-tuple match still sees the identity only at sc-14, a render discipline not to show the face, and a leak-gate RE-PROVE on the expanded base (a blind re-extraction confirming the identity is still first-re-extractable at sc-14). Downstream scope grows beyond a surgical repair: the render adds 3-5 BRAND-NEW prologue scenes of prose (not a 6-scene splice), the full PIN-A/B/C suite re-runs with the leak re-prove load-bearing, and a re-judge must weigh whether the bigger game is BETTER or just longer. And there is a genuine CRAFT TRADE-OFF flagged honestly (a creative consequence, not a cost): a prologue changes the story — the reader now knows from scene one that a figure feeds the dead (dramatic irony) before the party arrives; the hooded-figure design keeps the WHO a mystery but trades a tight cold-open for a fuller investigation channel, so tier (3) is a scope/taste decision, not a defect fix (v2 already judged high 5/4/5). BOTTOM LINE: tier (3) is feasible; the substrate + the proven authoring loop already handle the bulk; net character = a single small NEW-AUTHORING round (design + author + gate + render + judge), materially more than the surgical v2 repair but far less than a from-scratch game, dominated by the deed/identity withhold-split design and carrying a creative trade-off. Substrate finding kept: the R506 withhold layer is what makes tier (3) both non-trivial AND possible — a base that had withheld the DEED itself would have made it much harder; the public-deed/withheld-identity split here gives a clean seam to cut along. changes_bullets: BUILD: report-quest-graph (R559 design sec 7.38, R568 build) — the fact->quest leg, sibling of report-playable-world (R557), owning the R562 hand-JOIN. The existing substrate HONORS a discourse-order reveal — no new axis needed. Round 576 — ratify the structured-fact S.decision_summary: Ratify the structured-fact SSOT structure as the textbook fix for the pinion R1013.1 class (prose acting as a write-side source of store-homed facts: false supersede/decided/bundled claims that passed every gate). A structured fact (relation/status/binding) lives once in the store; current-state prose may only point/project, never restate; a syntactic lint forbids fact-assertion verbs beside a section ref in current-state surfaces, changelog audit-narrative exempt. Verification was the wrong frame (it presupposes two copies; SSOT forbids the second), so the prior claim-substantiation-gate draft is superseded. Reuse existing homes and verification (decision_status/superseded_by, BindingKind + max-rigor, R342/R574); typed relations are SSOT completion scoped to used relation verbs, not a speculative ontology. Design-only; build deferred pending open items (notably an open-question state has no DecisionStatus home).

Round 577 — implement v1 of the structur.decision_summary: Build v1 of the structured-fact SSOT design (ratified R576): a new opt-in prose-fact-assertion axis in validate-code-refs that flags a current-state code comment which RESTATES a structured fact (a relation/status verb adjacent to a §<id>) instead of pointing to it. The fact has a single store home (decision_status/superseded_by/bindings, authored via the mutate API); prose only projects. Deterministic and AI-free; opt-in via severity_prose_fact_assertion (None=off). Scoped to used relation/status verbs; implements excluded (binding idiom). The design acceptance test — the real R1013.1 comment shape — is rejected by the lint. Section-body surface, open/deferred-state verbs, and a CLI override are deferred per design sec 12.

New ViolationKind::ProseFactAssertion + DefectClass::ProseFactAssertion + extract_prose_fact_assertions helper (closed verb set, backtick-skipped, one hit per line, independent of whether the cited id resolves).

Round 582 — harden the prose-fact-assert.decision_summary: Respond to pinion's warn-adoption field report (it found real matcher false positives my unverified 'zero FP / zero section-prose' advisory claims missed). FP-1: skip a section ref inside a double-quoted span — a quoted verb+ref is a meta-mention (e.g. a corrective quoting the old overclaim to refute it), mirroring the backtick-skip, syntactic. FP-2: the section-prose finding no longer pins a single target ref — free-prose source->target binding is unreliable (passive voice bound the agent and produced source==target self-loops), so a target was false precision; the advisory finding now names only (section, field, verb). Both make the heuristic honestly coarse, NOT more precise. Declined the report's prose<->decision_status cross-check: it re-introduces the verification frame the SSOT design rejected (sec 9 forbids reject-grade precision on semantic prose); the value is already delivered by flag -> force-to-store -> R342/R574 rejecting false edges. The lint stays advisory (warn/info, never reject); the structural store invariants are the primary SSOT enforcement.
changes_bullets: FP-1: extract_prose_fact_assertions now skips a section ref inside a double-quoted span (in_quote state mirroring in_backtick) — a quoted verb+ref is a meta-mention (e.g. a corrective that quotes the old overclaim to refute it), not an assertion.

FP-2: SectionProseFinding drops the `target` field; the section-prose finding now names only (section_id, field, verb). Free-prose source->target binding is unreliable (passive voice "X superseded by Y" bound the agent and produced source==target self-loops), so a pinned target was false precision. CLI surface + test updated.

Both fixes are syntactic and make the heuristic honestly coarse, NOT more precise. Declined the report's prose<->decision_status cross-check (#3) and left the "deferred to" home doc (#4) out, per the "two cheap fixes only" scope.

Round 585.decision_summary: Register the AI-first-authoring support-surface debt: the deterministic, medium-neutral surfaces Mnemosyne must add so an external agent's generate-gate-repair loop authors narrative unattended at scale. The LLM loop stays an outside agent/MCP client; only these deterministic affordances land in the core. No build in this entry, debt registration only.
changes_bullets: describe-schema: emit the authoring contract as machine-readable data (entity kinds, predicate vocabulary, the quest encoding pursues/requires/completed_by with completion paying off an Expected setup, disclosure modes, typed-claim rules, all invariants) so an agent self-serves instead of reading source

propose-verdict transaction: one deterministic op = apply a candidate batch to a scratch sidecar, run every gate, return commit-or-rollback plus structured violations (today the loop hand-orchestrates import-facts + --sidecar + gates)
actionable violations: every gate violation carries rule + locus (fact/field) + expected + repair hint in --json, so an agent repairs programmatically rather than parsing prose

authoring-frontier report: one consolidated coverage-gap surface (scenes/nodes with zero facts, quests with no giver, dangling setups, never-planned disclosures, per-node coverage) an unattended loop pulls work from; today the pieces are scattered across payoff-coverage and disclosure-coverage
all-primitive batch manifest: one manifest importing facts + entities + quests + branches + disclosure for throughput (today only import-facts / import-sections)
AI-failure guardrail gates as Validator plugins: hallucinated-ref / wrong-branch / orphan / citation-hygiene deterministic checks via the existing PluginRegistry Validator slot
verification_bullets: grounded in this session's dogfood: authoring a 26-chapter game store in ../the-tide-that-counts surfaced each gap first-hand
read crates/mnemosyne-validate/src/continuity.rs to learn the quest convention (the describe-schema gap)
a batch failed mid-apply on one fact with a prose-only error (the transaction + actionable-violations gap)
hand-derived that two chapters had zero anchored facts (the authoring-frontier gap)
boundary confirmed against PluginRegistry: only SymbolResolver + Validator slots exist, both deterministic and compiled-in, so the LLM loop cannot be a plugin
carry_forward_bullets: pay in priority order: (1) describe-schema (largest correctness win), (2) propose-verdict transaction + actionable violations (the loop's atomic unit), (3) authoring-frontier report (unattended pull)
then: all-primitive batch manifest (throughput), guardrail Validator gates (feedback completeness)
invariant: the generate-gate-repair LLM loop stays an external agent/MCP client; only deterministic and medium-neutral surfaces land in the core
serves the north star: gates = self-consistency feedback, discovery = self-extraction, now made machine-actionable for an unattended agent

Round 607 — check_store_boundary exempts.decision_summary: A consumer (the-tide-that-counts, adapting a novel into a branching game) hit a false reject: add-branch <C> --converges main=<sec> --converges <fork>=<sec> succeeds at mutate, but every canon-order consumer (validate-continuity / report-fork-tree / report-payoff-coverage / manuscript) then fails with 'canon-order declares an edge set for branch main, which is not in the branch registry'. Root cause: check_store_boundary's declared-branch loop was the only one of four sibling registry checks missing the MAIN_BRANCH exemption. world_order_composition keys MAIN_BRANCH when main is a confluence PARENT (its own docstring: 'a confluence parent may be main'), that key flows through from_declaration into branch_reach, and declared_branches() then yields main — which the unguarded loop rejects because main is never registered. The fix adds the b != MAIN_BRANCH guard, identical to the fact / branch / world siblings in the same function. This unblocks the documented main-as-confluence-parent topology, letting a completed main trunk be re-woven with a forked braid without shattering the canon trunk into a dead prefix (the R601 fork-lineage trap).

Round 608 — the continuity gate scopes m.decision_summary: An adversarial self-review of R607 found the boundary fix was necessary but NOT total; R607's own carry-forward claimed 'every canon consumer unblocked / the fix is total', which is false. query_world_lineages — the lineage map consumed by scan_continuity, timeline_gaps, and edge_candidates — hardcoded main to Lineage::default() (empty forward) and computed lineage_of only for registered branches, and main is never a registered branch. The READ surfaces (payoff_coverage / frame_view / irony_intervals / playthrough_manuscript) instead call lineage_of per world, which computes forward = forward_confluences(world). So for a main-as-confluence-parent store the gate saw main.forward = {} while the view saw main.forward = {the confluence}. Consequence: a conflict between a main-exclusive-middle fact and a confluence-suffix fact returns None from join_world (the R535 forward arm lineages[main].forward.contains(suffix) is false), drops into cross_scope_pairs, and is NEVER checked — a silent false-negative in the flagship validate-continuity gate, for exactly the topology R607 unblocked. The gate and the view drifted, violating the 'holds_at is THE single holds-semantics shared by gate and view' invariant. Fix: query_world_lineages now flows main through the same lineage_of walk as every branch (main is no longer special-cased), making it genuinely 'THE single construction' its docstring claims. Byte-stable for pre-confluence stores, where forward_confluences(main) is empty so lineage_of(main) equals Lineage::default().
changes_bullets: query_world_lineages (continuity.rs): main flows through the same lineage_of walk as every registered branch instead of a hardcoded Lineage::default() — its forward confluence-suffixes are now populated when main is a confluence parent, so the construction is genuinely single-sourced

Round 611 — a fork off a confluence-chai.decision_summary: MNEMO-GAP-003, filed by the-tide-that-counts (the game-adaptation consumer) as the next step after GAP-002/R607: once the canon trunk becomes a CHAIN of confluences — which any upstream re-convergence braid creates — a DIVERGENT line forking off that trunk stops seeing the mid-trunk facts the merge displaced onto the confluence, even facts at-or-before its own fork point. Reproduced on the installed R609 CLI: with a braid re-converging into `weave` (which then OWNS the s3-s4 suffix), an `ending` forking off main@s3 lost `f-mid`@s3 — while `main` and the braid walked the full trunk correctly, so the re-convergence itself was never broken; only the fork off it was. ROOT CAUSE: fork inheritance was solved against the ancestor's OWNED facts rather than the ancestor's COMPOSED walk — `visibility`'s backward arm read only `fork_chain` (`cut`) and never the `forward_confluences` those ancestors flow into, so a re-convergence that moved a trunk segment onto a confluence made that segment invisible to anything forking off the trunk. The engine had already named this the deferred series-parallel generalization (the `join_world` docstring). DECISION: extend fork inheritance from "the ancestor's own facts" to "the ancestor's composed walk", BOUNDED at the departure — a third lineage relation `cut_forward` (a confluence an ancestor flows into -> that ancestor's departure point), resolved through the SAME bounded ladder `cut` uses. Three legs, because any one alone is a half-invariant: visibility (one fix point for every read surface), order composition (so the divergent world can compare a displaced coordinate to its fork), and join_world (so recorded-conflict scoping tracks the visibility instead of silently bucketing a co-holding pair as cross-scope). The BOUND is what stops a divergent ending from stealing the SHARED tail: it inherits the trunk prefix only up to its fork; the re-convergence suffix past it stays Out. Transitivity is free — `forward_confluences` is already a transitive closure, so a fork off a two-link chain inherits BOTH links (the consumer's real F1+F2+F4 topology). Byte-invariant for fork-only and single-confluence stores.

Round 612 — world-line membership is ONE.decision_summary: A cost-no-object review of R611 (three INDEPENDENT adversarial reviewers, the discipline the memory prescribes and that R611 skipped) returned a verdict I accept: cut_forward was a PATCH, not the model. R438 added one lineage relation, R533 a second, R611 a third — and each round the enumeration missed a case the next one would have to bolt on. The reviewers proved the miss is not hypothetical: a fork off a CONFLUENCE (the second link of every subway-braid chain, i.e. the consumer's actual F1+F2+F4 topology) lost the ENTIRE pre-merge trunk, silently; a non-monotone fork chain leaked; a confluence world returned a prefix-less fragment; and R611 left succession at the OLD width, so the gate would report a contradiction in a divergent world and then reject the only sanctioned way to fix it. DECISION: replace the enumerated relations with the series-parallel LATTICE the gap report itself pointed at. World-line membership is a map from branch to the departure coordinates a fact must be at-or-before — ALL of them, conjoined. FORK = conjoin a bound. MERGE = INTERSECT the parents. That is closed: a fork off a confluence, a fork off a fork off a confluence, nested confluences, a confluence whose parent is a confluence all fall out of those two rules, so there is no fourth relation to add, ever. Two consequences make it more than a refactor. (a) Carrying the bound as a SET rather than folding it into a `min` keeps the lattice ORDER-FREE, which is what finally lets the write path (succession) and the read path (visibility) share ONE definition instead of three that drift — the canon order compares against each bound later, at visibility time. (b) The intersection at a merge is a genuinely new and provably right semantics: a confluence continues only what EVERY incoming road carried, so the path-independent trunk survives while each parent's exclusive middle is dropped — which is exactly why a fork off it now inherits the trunk. join_world stops being a hand-enumerated relation and becomes the bounded visibility itself ("a world where BOTH facts are In"), which as a side effect CLOSES the sibling-confluence-common-parent case deferred since R533 — it literally is the "In-set intersection over the query worlds" that docstring said would be needed. HONEST BOUNDARY, stated so this entry cannot be misread: R612 fixes the FACT axis only. The COORDINATE axis (CanonOrder::names / linearize / is_maximal read R611's unbounded order widening) is STILL BROKEN — render-fidelity is blind for divergent worlds, the R488 wrong-branch guard is silent past the fork, and the pinion seam emits phantom scenes. Verified still reproducing after this round. That is the next round, and it must first answer a substrate question this arc exposed: a world-line has no declarable END.

Fork = conjoin a bound; merge = INTERSECT the parents. Memoised over the branch DAG, fails loud on a cyclic out-of-band edit

the lattice is ORDER-FREE (bounds are carried as a SET, not folded into a min), which is what lets the write path and the read path share ONE definition — the whole point, and why the bound is compared against the canon order later, at visibility time

Both arms require the successor to lie downstream — no leak-back, no sideways

Round 612 — world-line membership is ONE.publishable_decision_summary: A cost-no-object review of R611 (three INDEPENDENT adversarial reviewers, the discipline the memory prescribes and that R611 skipped) returned a verdict I accept: cut_forward was a PATCH, not the model. R438 added one lineage relation, R533 a second, R611 a third — and each round the enumeration missed a case the next one would have to bolt on. The reviewers proved the miss is not hypothetical: a fork off a CONFLUENCE (the second link of every subway-braid chain, i.e. the consumer's actual F1+F2+F4 topology) lost the ENTIRE pre-merge trunk, silently; a non-monotone fork chain leaked; a confluence world returned a prefix-less fragment; and R611 left succession at the OLD width, so the gate would report a contradiction in a divergent world and then reject the only sanctioned way to fix it. DECISION: replace the enumerated relations with the series-parallel LATTICE the gap report itself pointed at. World-line membership is a map from branch to the departure coordinates a fact must be at-or-before — ALL of them, conjoined. FORK = conjoin a bound. MERGE = INTERSECT the parents. That is closed: a fork off a confluence, a fork off a fork off a confluence, nested confluences, a confluence whose parent is a confluence all fall out of those two rules, so there is no fourth relation to add, ever. Two consequences make it more than a refactor. (a) Carrying the bound as a SET rather than folding it into a `min` keeps the lattice ORDER-FREE, which is what finally lets the write path (succession) and the read path (visibility) share ONE definition instead of three that drift — the canon order compares against each bound later, at visibility time. (b) The intersection at a merge is a genuinely new and provably right semantics: a confluence continues only what EVERY incoming road carried, so the path-independent trunk survives while each parent's exclusive middle is dropped — which is exactly why a fork off it now inherits the trunk. join_world stops being a hand-enumerated relation and becomes the bounded visibility itself ("a world where BOTH facts are In"), which as a side effect CLOSES the sibling-confluence-common-parent case deferred since R533 — it literally is the "In-set intersection over the query worlds" that docstring said would be needed. HONEST BOUNDARY, stated so this entry cannot be misread: R612 fixes the FACT axis only. The COORDINATE axis (CanonOrder::names / linearize / is_maximal read R611's unbounded order widening) is STILL BROKEN — render-fidelity is blind for divergent worlds, the R488 wrong-branch guard is silent past the fork, and the pinion seam emits phantom scenes. Verified still reproducing after this round. That is the next round, and it must first answer a substrate question this arc exposed: a world-line has no declarable END.
